reviewed_guards: Requires the exact previously reviewed installer bytes and root-private backup directory; disables bytecode writes before importing the installer as a module.
Acquires all five existing rollout locks non-blocking before reading or updating the prepared baseline.
Accepts only a non-empty subset of the two named native-core/checker protected-unit snapshot changes, requires changed units active, and requires every other snapshot field to remain identical.
Revalidates the prepared target manifest and file hashes and all four READY endpoints before preserving the original private snapshot and refreshing only the protected-unit baseline.
Calls the reviewed installer activation function under the held locks; that function switches/restarts only Identity and restores only the prior Identity pointer on failure.
operational_note: The original prepared snapshot is retained before its private working copy is renewed. If interruption occurs during that metadata transition, use the retained snapshot for a separately reviewed recovery; do not blindly rerun.
review_limits: Static read-only review only; script was not executed and no host calls were made.
No production database, auth configuration, fixture credentials, or other actor's work was modified.
